name: @midmanstudio/mdix
description: DixScript (.mdix) runtime for browser and Node.js via WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../mdix-wasm --target bundler --out-dir "$(pwd)/wasm-pkg" --out-name mdix_wasm && wasm-pack build ../mdix-wasm --target nodejs --out-dir "$(pwd)/wasm-pkg-node" --out-name mdix_wasm && rm -f wasm-pkg/.gitignore wasm-pkg-node/.gitignore
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts

author: MidManStudio
